Type: chair
Name: Strathwood Grand Isle Chaise Lounge Chair
Materials: Aluminum
Cushioned chaise with 5-position adjustable backrest for outdoor use; wide and roomy for maximum comfort Frame made of durable yet lightweight cast aluminum with black powder-coat finish; 100-percent Olefin cushion covers Attached seat and back cushions won't slide apart; centered buttons give a tailored look; corner ties secure cushions to frame; no assembly; imported Seat cushion measures 28.1 by 47.2 by 4 inches; back cushion measures 25.6 by 28.3 by 4 inches Measures 36 inches high by 75.2 inches long by 27.2 inches wide; weighs 38.6 pounds; no assembly required
